name: Congressional Disclosure Tracker
note: Free 45-minute trial with your email. Read-only, data frozen 12 September 2026.
noteIt: Prova gratuita di 45 minuti con la tua email. Sola lettura, dati congelati al 12 settembre 2026.

access.verification: 6-digit code or a link (GET shows a button, POST signs in), usable once for 15 minutes
access.oneTrialPer: canonical address: lower-cased, +tag dropped, Gmail dots dropped; throwaway domains refused
access.tracking: pages, members and tickers opened, locked features clicked, sign-ins; recorded against the address
access.admin: /admin, server-rendered, 404 without DEMO_ADMIN_TOKEN (>= 24 chars); grant another session, revoke, delete, CSV exports; plus one email per new sign-up to DEMO_NOTIFY_EMAIL
access.privacy: on the form: address, sign-in times, IP, what was opened; one session per person and to see how the demo is used; deleted 12 months after the last visit or on request to support@noeinsolutions.com; never added to a mailing list
access.mail: Neo (smtp0001.neo.space:587, STARTTLS) as support@noeinsolutions.com, through the mail-relay container; 3 codes per address per hour, 60 per hour and 200 per day in total, 5 new addresses per IP per day
access.killSwitch: DEMO_ACCESS_GATE=false opens the demo to anyone, unrecorded (local runs only)

session.clock: wall clock from the first sign-in, on the server; signing in again inside the window resumes it
session.firmness: firm: a second session needs a second real mailbox
session.store: visitors/codes/grants/events tables, SQLite on the `access` named volume
session.atEnd: every API call answers DEMO_EXPIRED and the app shows /access/ended: what they saw, a mailto to support@noeinsolutions.com, sign out; no restart. Asking for a code again mails an 'ended' note.
session.cleanup: nothing to delete per session (read-only); hourly purge of spent codes, of addresses never verified within 30 days, and of people unseen for 365 days with their events

open: Tickers (incl. price overlay from stored bars)

locked.feature: CSV downloads (Home net trade, Raw export)
locked.message: Downloading the dataset comes with full access. Every table and chart stays open on screen for the rest of your session.
Resolving, accepting and dismissing review rows comes with full access. The queue itself stays open to read.

removed: outbound network except the mail relay
tiers.decidedBy: owner, 2026-09-16: both CSV downloads locked although the data is public; nothing metered, since every read is local; 365-day retention; admin page plus an email per sign-up

data.refresh: python scripts/freeze_demo_data.py, commit and push the fixture, then bash ~/.claude/skills/hetzner-site/bin/site-deploy.sh from the repo root.

killSwitch.note: Unset or false and every demo route 404s (sign-in, /admin), the gate and the read-only guard stand down, the admin router is back and the banner never renders. Default off.

resets: Nothing to reset: every write to /api/* is refused while DEMO_MODE is on, so the snapshot a visitor sees is the snapshot the next visitor sees. The sign-in store is the only state, and it is meant to persist.
costPerVisit: none beyond one or two sign-in emails from the Neo mailbox (capped at 200 a day)
runLocally: python scripts/unpack_demo_snapshot.py && DEMO_MODE=1 DEMO_MAIL_BACKEND=console CONGRESS_DB_PATH=data/db/demo-snapshot.sqlite python -m src.api (the sign-in code is printed in the API log)
